people_research_summary: Gene Maida is identified on Georgian's official consultation page as founder and president and as the authorial voice behind its design education.
outreach_email:
Subject: Extending Georgian's Feasibility Study into a capital plan

Gene, Georgian's Boyer Boulevard case stood out because the project began with your Feasibility Study—not after drawings and budget decisions were already locked. FairLend specializes in construction financing, and our DrawFlow workflow can translate an approved project budget and proposed milestones into a clear capital-availability path while Georgian keeps the client and build relationship. Would you test this on one anonymized study in a 20-minute working session? No live borrower data and no commitment required.
outreach_linkedin: Gene — I liked how Georgian makes the Feasibility Study the foundation of projects like Boyer Boulevard. We help builders add a construction-finance readiness layer at that exact point, including a proposed DrawFlow milestone map. Open to comparing it against one redacted study?
outreach_phone_and_form: Phone opener: I am calling because Georgian already does the scope-and-budget work lenders need through its Feasibility Study. We would like to test a builder-preserving finance handoff on one anonymized file. Form fallback: reference Boyer Boulevard and ask for Gene or the person responsible for pre-construction partnerships.
outreach_followups: Day 3: send a one-page mock finance-readiness overlay for the Feasibility Study.
Day 8: share a redacted DrawFlow milestone/evidence example.
Day 15: close the loop with a choice of a 20-minute review or permission to revisit when the next custom-build feasibility file appears.
outreach_asset: Co-branded Georgian Feasibility Study finance-readiness overlay with borrower-consent and referral-status fields.
outreach_guardrails: Describe FairLend as an FSRA-licensed mortgage brokerage and administrator specializing in private lending and construction financing. DrawFlow is milestone-based increasing availability: FairLend separately approves and releases funds under the financing agreement; interest accrues only on capital advanced. Never promise approval, timing, draw release, permit, appraisal or savings. Start with redacted data and preserve Georgian's client ownership.
